## A {.unnumbered}

**Astronomy**
: the study of space and objects outside of Earth. *(See [intro-to-physical-science](physics/intro-to-physical-science.qmd).)*

## C {.unnumbered}

**Chemistry**
: the study of the properties of matter and how matter changes. *(See [intro-to-physical-science](physics/intro-to-physical-science.qmd).)*

## E {.unnumbered}

**Engineering**
: the branch of science and technology concerned with the design, building, and use of machines and structures. *(See [intro-to-physical-science](physics/intro-to-physical-science.qmd).)*

## O {.unnumbered}

**Observation**
: obtaining information through your senses. *(See [intro-to-science](physics/intro-to-science.qmd).)*

## P {.unnumbered}

**Physics**
: the study of matter and energy and how they interact. *(See [intro-to-physical-science](physics/intro-to-physical-science.qmd).)*
